basis: July-October 2016; each month scored by a model trained on the other three (assay/crossfit.py); labels are the bank's closed cases

structuring.unit: burst of >=3 online $400-$500 on a card within an hour
structuring.note: scored at the burst's strongest transaction, as the agent does

card_testing.unit: run of >=3 online < $5 within an hour, then a purchase >= $20
card_testing.note: scored at the strongest follow-on purchase

ring.unit: transaction from a device profile that is a ring within +-30 days
ring.note: 1 qualifying profile(s), 24 cards: effectively one cluster, so the interval understates the uncertainty

memory.unit: transaction on a card with confirmed fraud opened > 1 day earlier
memory.note: what the agent's case memory asserts when it finds an earlier fraud verdict on the card
